title: Consumer Protection Act, 2020 (No. 10 of 2020)
citation: Consumer Protection Act, 2020 (No. 10 of 2020), s.42 False, misleading or deceptive representations
evidence: S.I. 2021 No. 78 (Gazetted 13 July 2021): "I hereby appoint the 9th day of July, 2021 to be the date on which the Consumer Protection Act, 2020 shall come into force." Opened https://laws.gov.vg/sites/default/files/2024-04/S.I.%20No.%2078%20of%202021-NOTICE%20-%20Consumer%20Protection%20Act%2C%202020.pdf on 2026-11-10 (sha256 3609866e6ac57389b0b62041da4284b8a35e72e39b444f0d61430e9f8ea05e36).
notes: Section 42(1)(a): with respect to goods or services that are the subject of a consumer agreement or in their marketing, the supplier shall not, by words or conduct, "directly or indirectly express or imply a false, misleading or deceptive representation concerning a material fact to a consumer". No environmental or green-claim wording was found in the section; it is a general misleading-representation duty that a green claim can fall under. Act PDF as gazetted 13 July 2020 (sha256 a77ebf97a63e1b6ad2892e73f427d0689e1a880437d6a897a2c911e5abbd0855). The Act is amended by the Consumer Protection (Amendment) Act, 2026. Link only: the licence row is permission requested (the Attorney General's Chambers asks to be contacted before the official text is reproduced or distributed). English is the only official language; no translation row is needed.

title: Consumer Protection (Amendment) Act, 2026 (No. 6 of 2026)
evidence: No commencement clause: the Act has only a short title (s.1). Assented 27 August 2026 and "Gazetted 3rd September, 2026"; no commencement notice is listed on https://laws.gov.vg/Laws/consumer-protection-amendment-act-2026. Opened https://laws.gov.vg/sites/default/files/2026-09/Act%20No%206%20of%202026-Consumer%20Protection%20%28Amendment%29%20Act%2C%202026.pdf on 2026-11-10 (sha256 ea848f901410ca47622bf1179bc14faa4a9dc828beed581b88a15e32aae5c038).
notes: Inserts a Part IIIA (Consumer Affairs Tribunal) and amends sections 2, 6, 7, 9, 20, 26, 52, 75, 77, 80, 82, 84, 86, 100 and 108 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2020, and inserts a Schedule. It does not amend section 42 as listed in its arrangement of sections. The in-force date is not stated on an official page read, so it stays null. Link only: the licence row is permission requested (the Attorney General's Chambers asks to be contacted before the official text is reproduced or distributed). English is the only official language; no translation row is needed.

title: Environmental Protection and Tourism Improvement Fund Act, 2017 (No. 7 of 2017)
citation: Environmental Protection and Tourism Improvement Fund Act, 2017 (No. 7 of 2017), s.3 environmental and tourism levy
evidence: S.I. 2024 No. 23 (Gazetted 3 April 2024): "I hereby appoint the 1st day of September, 2017 to be the date on which the Environmental Protection and Tourism Improvement Fund Act, 2017 shall be deemed to have come into force." Opened https://laws.gov.vg/sites/default/files/2024-07/SI%20No%2023%20of%202024-Notice%20for%20Environmental%20Protection%20and%20Tourism%20Improvement%20Fund%20Act%2C%202017%20to%20be%20brought%20into%20force.pdf on 2026-11-10 (sha256 c98beeb5219a67541ea7fd573fb2a281b03a22ccd890b2c695844336a6bb6ea6).
notes: Narrower than a carbon price (keep-and-mark rule, Varun 2026-11-10): s.3(1) sets a levy "called an environmental and tourism levy at the rate of $10.00" on "each non-resident passenger arriving in the Virgin Islands by air or sea", paid into a fund for "the protection and improvement of the environment, the tourism product". It is not charged on emissions or fuel. The laws.gov.vg page title reads "Environmental Protection and Improvement Fund Act, 2017"; the Act and its notice print "Tourism". Act PDF sha256 62a6d3bb5fc18f424789a75582935637b03ed28fd58559141af4a69cd425a67a. Link only: the licence row is permission requested (the Attorney General's Chambers asks to be contacted before the official text is reproduced or distributed). English is the only official language; no translation row is needed.

title: Virgin Islands Climate Change Trust Fund Act, 2015 (No. 12 of 2015)
citation: Virgin Islands Climate Change Trust Fund Act, 2015 (No. 12 of 2015)
evidence: Section 1: "This Act may be cited as the Virgin Islands Climate Change Trust Fund Act, 2015 and shall come into force on a date the Minister may, by Notice published in the Gazette appoint." No commencement notice is listed on https://laws.gov.vg/Laws/virgin-islands-climate-change-trust-fund-act-2015 (read 2026-11-10; the page lists no subsidiary legislation). Act PDF opened the same day (sha256 2a264135663ea19beaad8e52bcd8d50840030b0562999894c3a7c1521f617e91).
notes: Establishes a trust fund for climate change adaptation and mitigation work; it is a funding vehicle, not a climate framework act with targets or duties on emitters. No commencement notice was found, so it is not known to be in force. Link only: the licence row is permission requested (the Attorney General's Chambers asks to be contacted before the official text is reproduced or distributed). English is the only official language; no translation row is needed.
